rationale: Sampled ContinuityOps is a coherent repo-only reliability lab: Terraform validates, Helm chart tests pass, serverless and agentic/alert unit gates are green, and claims labeling is mostly honest. Merge readiness fails on qualitative grounds — Stage 2 remediation is still open, plan-approval/status drift remains, evidence SHAs lag HEAD, and S7 restore/performance artifacts are explicitly unmeasured synthetics — not because of any numeric pass bar.
